svg.title: Purchased component support and subsequent material issue
svg.desc: Purchased component support and subsequent material issue. Purchasing and receiving support component availability. A separate work-order material issue records components moving into production. Read each numbered connector with its evidence explanation. Reference paths are not a time sequence; analytical support and account effects do not create additional stored keys.
